title: EvoSkill: Automated Skill Discovery for Agents

mechanism.populationDetail: A score-bearing frontier of skill-containing agent programs is retained; the notes do not report islands or a tree.
mechanism.archiveDetail: The validation frontier retains multiple skill-bearing programs when held-out performance improves; no niche descriptor is reported.
mechanism.replacementDetail: Frontier admission is based on held-out validation improvement; exact capacity/pruning policy is not stated in the note.
mechanism.generationDetail: Failure analysis can propose a new structured skill or edit an existing skill folder.
mechanism.outOfTaxonomy: Evolution and retention operate over structured reusable skill folders embedded in agent programs.

provenance.sourcePdf: additional_papers/202603/EvoSkill Automated Skill Discovery for Agents.pdf
provenance.citationWarning: Frontier capacity and exact parent/operator rules are not specified; multi-elite and hybrid add/edit mappings follow the evidence note and remain provisional.
